issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency for the milking interface: the Problem Statement and UML require an interface named `Milkable` with method `messageOnMilk()`, and the template's commented Main references `Milkable` (e.g., Milkable[] milkables in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java). The Solution repository instead defines an interface named `Dairy` (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Dairy.java) and has Goat and Seal implement `Dairy` (Goat.java: implements Dairy; Seal.java: implements Dairy). Additionally, there is an empty Milkable.java file in the Solution repository. This mismatch (expected name Milkable vs implemented name Dairy) will confuse students about which interface to implement and may lead to compilation or integration issues when following the problem statement.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the interface name across artifacts. Preferred fixes: (a) Rename the Solution's `Dairy` interface to `Milkable` (update file name to Milkable.java and the interface declaration) and have Goat and Seal implement `Milkable`; or (b) if keeping `Dairy`, update the problem statement/UML and template references to use `Dairy` consistently. Also remove or populate the empty Milkable.java in the solution so there is a single authoritative interface. Ensure the interface declares messageOnMilk() as specified.
